title: EOS FACE v0.1 Intent/Need → Work Formation Protocol Boundary Implementation
user_job: Human enters EOS Face, submits "Saya ingin mendirikan PT untuk bisnis saya.", EOS resolves intent, forms canonical Work, redirects to existing /work/[id] reality
acceptance_criteria.f1_human_can_express_need: Browser displays formation surface where human can input their need
acceptance_criteria.f2_need_becomes_intent_contract: Need is persisted as IntentContract with expression, source, context fields
acceptance_criteria.f4_intent_resolution_understandable: Resolution generates objective: "Establish a PT", domain: "Legal / Company Formation", expected outcome: "Legally established company"
acceptance_criteria.f5_human_can_inspect_understanding: Browser displays EOS understanding to human before creation
acceptance_criteria.f6_human_confirms_formation: Human clicks [Start Work] to confirm work creation
acceptance_criteria.f7_real_work_id_created: Database stores real Work ID (not mock/temporary)
acceptance_criteria.f9_existing_work_reality_loads: All existing Work Reality components load on /work/[id]
acceptance_criteria.f10_state_machine_remains_intact: Existing state machine functions without modifications
acceptance_criteria.f11_next_action_remains_executable: Next Action button is clickable and executes existing commands
acceptance_criteria.f12_action_produces_existing_evidence: Evidence is generated in the same format as all other Work
acceptance_criteria.f13_refresh_preserves_work: Page refresh retains all Work data from database
acceptance_criteria.f14_no_duplicate_work: Only one Work created per intent submission, no duplicates
acceptance_criteria.f15_intent_work_provenance_traceable: formedInto relationship exists in evidence chain linking Intent to Work
acceptance_criteria.f16_second_actor_can_continue_work: Different actor can load the Work and execute next actions
acceptance_criteria.build_typescript_clean: npm run build and npm run check-types pass with zero errors related to formation layer
acceptance_criteria.e2e_all_pass: All Playwright E2E tests pass for golden path
acceptance_criteria.browser_evidence_captured: Screenshots and browser traces captured for verification
